entry.name: mcs.sig~
entry.digest: Convert numbers to audio signals (multichannel output)
entry.description: Use the mcs.sig~ object to convert a list of numbers into a multi-channel audio signal.

arguments.name: initial-output-value
arguments.description: One or more numbers set the initial output signal values. The number of values entered determines the number of channels in the multi-channel output signal.
